subtitle: No manual intervention, no external orchestrator

code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK apply_customer_changes
    WAREHOUSE = analytics_wh
    SCHEDULE = '5 MINUTE'
    WHEN SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA('customers_stream')
AS
    MERGE INTO customers_dim AS tgt
    USING customers_stream AS src
        ON tgt.customer_id = src.customer_id
    WHEN MATCHED AND src.METADATA$ACTION = 'INSERT'
        THEN UPDATE SET tgt.name = src.name
    WHEN NOT MATCHED AND src.METADATA$ACTION = 'INSERT'
        THEN INSERT (customer_id, name)
        VALUES (src.customer_id, src.name);
caption: The same MERGE pattern from Lesson 9 — now fed only by what changed.
